articles.summary: Smart Data dramatically improves MTTK and reduces AI token consumption helping organizations accelerate and control AI-driven operations as they advance toward autonomous IT NETSCOUT ® SYSTEMS, INC. (NASDAQ: NTCT), a leading provider of observability, AIOps, cybersecurity, and DDoS attack protection solutions, expands its data platform to provide the trusted operational context required to build the foundation for enterprise AI. The NETSCOUT data platform observes digital interactions, converts packets into high-fidelity, compact, contextualized evidence in real time, and curates that evidence at scale for observability, service assurance, cybersecurity, and AI. This addresses a growing barrier to enterprise AI adoption: increasingly capable models still cannot deliver reliable operational decisions when the data supplied to them is incomplete, noisy, fragmented, or stripped of context.
